text:
incident-bot: PAGER: PROD - Minerva (enterprise, VPC) - elevated 5xx rate from eu-west-2 dedicated pool. paging irene (oncall) and samir (sre) - Sev2

irene (oncall): acked, taking incident lead. oncall handover incoming from night shift.

samir (sre): thanks. quick summary? what are the signals?

irene (oncall): metrics: 5xx rate on minerva-prod-vpool-eu-west avg 12% over 3m, p99 latency spiked. customer Lee (Minerva Ops) reporting increased errors.

kelly (eng-plat): seeing backend kernel OOM alerts on that pool, probably memory pressure on quantized runtime. autoscale tried +2 nodes but they flapped.

zach (eng-runtime): we observed KV cache thrash after long sequences from a tenant burst. workaround attempt: reduce worker ram per process to force lighter batches? risky.

marta (acct mgr): pinging customer, Lee is on the line. need ETA and mitigation steps to tell them.

lee (customer-ops): on call at Minerva. Confirming traffic degraded for eu-west, requests time out ~10-30s then 5xx. Can you route us to other region? Our clients are sensitive to DNS TTLs.

irene (oncall): plan: 1) warm standby in eu-central already warmed for Minerva (reserved pool). 2) reduce DNS TTL for customer's CNAME to 30s, trigger cutover to eu-central endpoint. 3) keep dedicated pool in eu-west in read-only/drain mode for diagnostics. 4) monitor errors and rollback if needed. Anyone see blockers?

samir (sre): agree. pre-checks: provisioned capacity in eu-central: 40% headroom, kv-cache primed yesterday. I'll validate warm tokens and routing.

david (netops): I'll prep the DNS change and coordinate with our edge proxy team. recommend 30s TTL change now, then CNAME swap.

kelly (eng-plat): note: our smart-routing has a fallback policy but customer has pinned region in metadata. we'll need to bump their routing policy to allow cross-region. I can push a one-off policy change.

zach (eng-runtime): running quick health probe against eu-central pool:
```
curl -sS -H "Host: minerva.example-cust.net" https://eu-central-runner.redwood-internal/ping
# expected 200, got 200, avg 12ms
```

samir (sre): done validation: capacity ok. initiating customer policy toggle to allow routing to eu-central. leaving audit notes.

marta (acct mgr): Lee, letting you know we'll start the failover in ~5m. Will send formal blurb for your support channels.

lee (customer-ops): copy. we'll pause client-side region pinning. Ready on our side.

david (netops): changing DNS TTL now to 30s for minerva-cust.example.com -> will propagate in ~30-90s.

incident-bot: CHANGELOG: DNS TTL updated for minerva-cust.example.com by david at 2628005120.

david (netops): pushing CNAME swap to point to eu-central-runner and updating edge routing.

kelly (eng-plat): pushed routing policy: customer.minerva.allow_cross_region=true (audit-id: audit-2628005251).

irene (oncall): starting traffic shift: using gradual weighted shift over 5 steps (25% -> 50% -> 75% -> 100%). monitor business metrics and 5xx. Samir watch for error spike.

samir (sre): step1 (25%) done. 5xx dropped from 12% -> 4.3%. latency p95 improving.

lee (customer-ops): seeing fewer errors from our clients already. good so far.

samir (sre): step2 (50%) done. 5xx now 1.2%. no new OOMs observed.

zach (eng-runtime): runtime logs look stable; KV cache hit ratio up in eu-central. leaving extra monitoring on for 30m.

kelly (eng-plat): step3 (75%) -> hold. small bump in request durations for minority of flows, but error rate stays low.

marta (acct mgr): composing short status update for customer: "We are performing an automated regional failover for Minerva to our eu-central warm pool to mitigate degraded behavior in eu-west. Impact should be minimized; continuing to monitor. ETA for full cutover 10-15m." Lee ok with send?

lee (customer-ops): send it. include our contact for any rollback.

incident-bot: DEPLOY: Routing policy change rolled back? none. No automatic rollback triggered.

samir (sre): step4 (100%) -> traffic on eu-central. metrics stable, 5xx <0.5%. marking state: mitigated.

david (netops): leaving DNS TTL at 30s until we confirm stability for 2 hours. we can increase later.

irene (oncall): good job team. next actions: 1) keep eu-west pool quarantined for forensic capture (do not restart). 2) run deeper memory / trace dumps with eng-runtime. 3) coordinate postmortem and customer RCA. Zach and Samir to lead.

zach (eng-runtime): will collect heap profiles and KV traces. starting capture now (no restarts).

samir (sre): i'll open incident ticket and book postmortem meeting. tentative severity: Sev2 -> will consider upgrade if root cause shows wider risk.

marta (acct mgr): following up with customer comms and support bridge summary. Lee, I'll share the internal incident channel so you can join the postmortem if desired.

lee (customer-ops): appreciated. main ask: ensure we get a technical RCA and whether we need to change any client-side timeouts.

irene (oncall): logging timeline + handoff. leaving this thread open for 2h monitoring. oncall shift at 0300 UTC will pick up.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Minerva regional failover to eu-central completed at 2628007799. Status: mitigated.

irene (oncall): closing loop for now. thanks all. :thumbsup:
